sections.title: 3. Волны PHPStan: P09.1–P09.3
sections.text:
P09.1: foundation core + root scripts/tests/Support/tests/Golden + access-azguard (0 baseline). Создать scripts/quality/release-quality.php с --stage=foundation|security|all; stage verifies existing configs include max/strict/bleedingEdge, paths cover src+owned database/migrations, empty ignoreErrors for completed cohort, ceilings zero there; непрошедшие пакеты остаются под текущим shrinking ratchet до своей волны. Stage gate не подменяет запуск PHPStan. Добавить root Arch QualityReleaseGateTest: suppression moved inline/removed source path/nonzero ceiling must fail. Встроить named final stage into CI только когда все волны доведены, чтобы не искусственно закрывать red earlier lanes.
P09.2: access (30). P09.10: tenancy (232). P09.11: operations/tools/webhooks (137/16/194). These three sequential items replace the former 609-count item; package boundaries determine rollback and test lanes. P09.3: остальные 14 пакетов (custom-fields,intl,media,notifications,panels,recurrence,search,search-intl,search-meilisearch,tasks,tasks-workflow,transfer,wakeup,workflow) и products/flex-crm; foundation/security already cleared. Inventory table gives complete directories (14 remaining packages + one product).
На config выполнить PHPStan diagnostic без baseline в отдельном временном config рядом с original, сохранив relative include resolution; JSON ошибки записать по path/identifier. Это diagnostic, не acceptance. Исправлять по причине: mixed boundary -> runtime is_array/is_string/array shape validation; Collection/Builder generic -> model type + relation types; container make -> known contract/interface + asserts where true; Eloquent dynamic property -> declared casts/real column/types; callable -> Closure signatures; nullable -> explicit checked branch. PHPDoc должен отражать runtime, нельзя @var claim неизвестного типа. Исправить прямые callers/tests, не public signatures для удобства анализа. Осмысленные new branch tests для behavior, type-only mass annotations проверяются existing lanes. Перегенерировать только уменьшенную baseline как промежуточный diagnostic; в конце stage каждый файл `parameters: ignoreErrors: []` и --tighten ceiling=0. Не оставлять unmatched-ignore/reportUnmatchedIgnore отключения.
Shared foundation change: root and all package analysis/test consumers; package-only correction: own affected SQLite/PG lanes; --release-quality stage confirms completed waves haven't regressed. Full aggregate one time P09.7, не после каждого локального edit.

P09.1 first tightens ALL current measured baseline/dependency ceilings with scripts/php84 php scripts/quality-ceiling-guard.php --tighten, then reads diff and verifies no increases. Starting total PHPStan ceiling 2710 vs baseline 1975 is no excuse to retain slack; record actual after P08 repair before removing foundation debt. Repeat tighten at each wave completion; no execution is performed during design.
V0: P08.10 done is necessary but insufficient. Require P08 final commit, workflow CI run id, completed/success and all required jobs success under D73, compare final product fingerprints; scripts/.plan-close-deferred must be absent. P09.1 authority is runtime owner_gate P09-DESIGN-P08: current independent different-model design review and prior phase hosted closure, not a status inferred from item done.
Freshness (G4 corrected pre/post contract): original artifacts/P09-design/facts.json is immutable historical input, never regenerated just to make equality true. P09.1 creates scripts/quality/facts-guard.py and tests first as a bounded new-file bootstrap; do not edit any original measured PHPStan/Pint/Rector/ceiling/schema/manifest input or run --tighten before pre capture. `pre` calls original facts.py and compares against design JSON; unknown delta exits1 listing exact field/path. Closed-P08 rebase is a separate build/quality/P09.1/p08-rebase.json containing EXACT dotted changed keys (e.g. anchors.scripts/schema-gate.php, anchors.scripts/quality-ceilings.json, root_baseline_count when actually changed), previous+current value/hash, owning closed P08 item, final P08 CI run/SHA and rationale. No anchors.* wildcard, no new unreviewed keys, no auto-populated allowance from current output. Source commit change is allowed only by recorded P08 closed-source/unchanged-product plan-only lineage, never by ignoring all hashes. Investigate discrepancy, explicitly record verified delta, then pre returns0 and seals facts-pre.json plus full tracked/nonignored product file hash inventory and frozen exact item write allowlist. Capture actual facts and hash pre receipt before typing/style/tighten edits. Build/plans/log output is outside product inventory; unrelated dirty changes retained and hashed as pre state. A declared new guard file may bootstrap before pre; this never relaxes measured legacy inputs.
`verify-pre` (V2) checks the immutable sealed pre receipt against design snapshot + explicit closed-P08 rebase provenance; it does NOT compare end-of-item current facts with1975 design debt. Completion records this captured pre proof. `post` (V19) measures current tree against captured pre, checks package identity/type/dependency/coverage/path inventory and every file/anchor OUTSIDE frozen own write allowlist unchanged. Own allowlist expands P09.1 task_files to exact pre-existing paths plus exact declared created files before edits, records intended field changes and before hashes; no retrospective 'every path in my diff is allowed'. Root/core baselines shrink to0 and their ceilings change as intended; remaining baselines/ceilings must not grow (all-ceiling initial --tighten allowed decreases only); manifest requires/types/channels stay unchanged. Owned config changes preserve src+all actual migration analysis paths/max/strict/bleedingEdge; excluded measurement paths/fields cannot vanish. Source_commit is not compared to old design SHA post-change; post verifies lineage to pre SHA and exact current diff subset of frozen scope, own source/receipt bindings and no unlisted dirty-file changes. No manual lifecycle waiver or facts.json overwrite is required to finish. Any unapproved drift returns1. Explicit approved own extension before mutation requires re-freezing allowlist with rationale, never hiding already observed unrelated changes.
Future commands in item V2/V19/V20 belong facts-guard.py authored here; examples state exact receipt fields and negative controls. Pre raw receipt retained, post is distinct final measured snapshot. Both are recorded with path+digest in Completion Notes; pre success isn't rerun against a changed design baseline. Negative tests: unknown schema/P08 anchor delta, wildcard allowance, wrong P08 SHA/run, mutable pre receipt, missing original path, unrelated package manifest/baseline change, retroactive allowlist widening → RED. Owned root/core baseline/pint/rector diff with unchanged other identities/paths and preserved ceiling ratchet → post0.

No tools PG suite exists (failOnEmptyTestSuite=true): tools uses SQLite suite plus pg-inventory negative check. Access test embeds --exclude-group=pg; its PG acceptance is composer --working-dir=packages/access test:pg. Other PG lanes only where inventory proves nonempty.

sections.title: 4. P09.4: Rector, final/readonly/named, unused-public
sections.text:
Add root dev driftingly/rector-laravel:2.6.2, configure php84:true, LaravelSetProvider and Laravel code-quality/collection/type declarations sets only; no composer-based LARAVEL_130 because PHP84/Laravel12 is lowest supported. Explicit file discovery packages/*/src + packages/*/tests + products/*/src/tests + scripts/**/*.php + root tests; exclude vendor/delivery/plans captures/generated Golden fixtures and immutable released database/migrations. Since rc not yet released, type fixes in baseline SQL-PHP may be necessary in P09.1–3; behavior/golden equivalence is required and cutover hashes pinned at qualification. Never automatic framework upgrade without supported-version proof.
Use scratch worktree for broad mechanical Rector application: no edits to unrelated dirty work, map diff before apply. Run Rector then Pint then analysis then affected behavior lanes; no rule skip lists to hide findings. Final/readonly scan uses PHPParser AST (already installed) in scripts/quality/release-quality.php --stage=all, and precise source linked exception list for framework-required inheritable test bases; production subclassable bases must already be SPI or an explicit API decision. Do not add Spi merely to silence final gate. Named-arg rule resolves only known user code declarations; retain dynamic/variadic/external positional calls. Coverage roots unaffected.
Implement scripts/quality/unused-public.php --check: scan public Internal members and exported classes; build usage from whole source/tests/config/manifests/provider/serializer registrations; Api/Spi public roots must have intended external use docs, not inferred dead. Exact source-symbol ledger scripts/quality/public-entrypoints.json records reason and source anchor/hash, stale ledger fails. Unused Internal methods remove or privatize only after dynamic hooks checked; dead exported surface requires finite decision-bound BC delta+CHANGELOG+Golden, not omission from API snapshot. Tests: unreferenced Internal method RED, documented Api/Spi entrypoint GREEN, method called through DI/manifest GREEN, expired/wildcard ledger RED. Keep dependency analyser separately all roots 0 ratchet.
Migration protection is installed in P09.1 before any broad tooling run and retained in P09.4: Rector withSkip contains real absolute expanded packages/*/database/migrations and products/*/database/migrations directory roots; Pint notPath regex ^(?:packages|products)/[^/]+/database/migrations/.*\.php$. Preserve every current Pint exclusion. Protection applies to root, tenant, tenant-cloud, budget and all nested baseline files. PHPStan continues to include those owned paths. New tests/Arch/MigrationToolingGuardTest.php uses temp source fixture, snapshots SHA256 of all declared migration PHP files, applies Rector+Pint there and requires identical bytes. Plant a rewriteable/poorly formatted migration and remove each protection independently: corresponding tooling rewrites it and guard exits1; restore exclusion gives exit0 with same migration hash. Merely parsing config or dry-run exit0 does not prove this guard. Metadata/Golden equality cannot substitute for byte equality. Hand type correction is permitted only pre-release with schema/Golden/API checks, never automatic cosmetic rewriting.

sections.title: 5. P09.5: MSI invariant model and runbook
sections.text:
P09.9 is a bounded compatibility spike BEFORE P09.5 runner and test work. Observed lock: Pest 5.2.1, PHPUnit 13.3.4, Rector 2.6.7; Infection not installed. Target Infection 0.35.6 is from primary capture; compatibility is UNVERIFIED. In disposable worktree solve exact dependency with composer why-not on conflict; preserve Pest/PHPUnit/runtime floors. Create scripts/quality/infection-spike.py, infection-compatibility.json and raw adapter reports: one real packages/tenancy fragment on PHP8.4/8.5 × Laravel12/13, SQLite + required PG *_test coverage XML/JUnit, uncovered and timeout/error controls. Log actual PHP/Pest/PHPUnit/Infection versions, command/help flags, adapter and lock hashes. Initial tests must run through actual Pest runner, then Infection executes --with-uncovered --with-timeouts and reports a real generated/killed/escaped mutant. A trivial PHPUnit-only test is insufficient. Budget 2h, stop with concrete conflicts at limit. Preferred route supported native testframework adapter with custom Pest executable. If incompatible, implement bounded Infection testframework adapter (process invokes the pinned Pest CLI; same fresh coverage/reports/exit contracts), replay the identical matrix in this item, max additional 2h. If adapter proof still fails, item blocked; owner/plan-author decision to adopt another full-source engine with identical metrics is required before P09.5. No Pest/PHPUnit downgrade, fixed patch MSI substitute, threshold relaxation or report parser fabrication. Spike --check receipt validates successful matrix; failure keeps downstream dependency unsatisfied.

P09.5 creates locked runner, exhaustive zones, self-tests, CI shards; it does not own unbounded behavior test improvements. P09.12 improves security95; P09.13 messaging90; P09.14 other75. Exact inventory of every committed packages/*/src and products/flex-crm/src PHP file; unmatched/multiply assigned file RED. Deterministic longest-path precedence: security packages/{access,access-azguard,tenancy,tools,webhooks}, core/{Context,Tenancy,Database,Data}, core/Modules/Internal/Gate and operations/Authorization. Messaging core/Messaging, remaining operations, packages/{wakeup,workflow,tasks-workflow,transfer}; other all remaining source. Empty configured production path fails inventory and is corrected against actual source, never silently omitted.

Acceptance is PER PACKAGE-FRAGMENT (package × zone), not pooled zone MSI. Every behavioral fragment must generate >0 valid mutants and achieve its own 95/90/75%; aggregates are diagnostics only. Source-only declaration file may have zero mutants only if PHPParser AST proves all nodes are interfaces/abstract declarations/enums or immutable DTO storage with no mutatable expressions/branches; exact path+source hash+AST reason is in zero-ledger. A whole fragment may be declaration-only (e.g. thin bridge/contracts) only if EVERY file meets that predicate and exclusion ledger is explicitly confirmed by P09.8; classify N/A-declaration, never numeric MSI100/GREEN, still run API/PHPStan/schema tests. One behavior file with zero generated/valid mutants makes fragment RED. Arbitrary zero-file reason is insufficient. All 3 zone inventories must have actual behavioral fragments; whole empty zone RED.

Runner initial green SQLite+required PG tests produce fresh XML+JUnit, source/test/config/tool/lock hashes bound to each package sandbox. PG-only method coverage cannot be replaced with SQLite. Generate fragment Infection config in build/quality, --with-uncovered --with-timeouts --threads=1. Strict score =100*killed-by-tests/valid; timeouts, escaped, uncovered are denominator members, timeouts never killed. No process errors count as killed. Syntax-invalid exclusion needs raw mutant source + actual PHP syntax-check failing at its mutant location. Compile-invalid additionally needs deterministic standalone reproduction proving original loads, mutant load fails due changed declaration; type assertion/test exception is a behavioral result, not compile invalid. Unknown error/DB/adapter/coverage/OOM infrastructure is blocking. Preserve raw process/exit/stdout/stderr and exact report field classification.

Concrete self-tests from locked Infection spike logs: parse error mutant (php -l fails, excluded syntax); duplicate/redeclared method incompatible signature (php -l may pass, isolated load deterministically fails, excluded compile only with proof); PHPUnit discovery/bootstrap error, missing Pest executable, missing XML/JUnit, PDO connection-refused, process exit137/OOM and unrecognized JSON status (infrastructure RED); PHPUnit assertion failure (killed); time limit (timeout valid, not killed); malformed/unreadable report, missing PG coverage, stale source/test/lock and fragment omission (RED). Compare actual locked log schema to parser fixtures; --self-test proves parser only, zone runs prove metrics. Boundary fixtures 94.99/95 and 89.99/90.

Equivalent ledger exact mutant+source/hash+reason/replay needs independent confirmation. Equivalent exclusions ceiling <=5% of pre-equivalence valid generated mutants IN EACH fragment (no minimum-count rounding allowance), also <=5% globally; >ceiling RED, no agent waiver. This cap is a new stricter design rule, requires independent design review before admission. Parse/compile exclusions are reported separately and individually reproduced, cannot be renamed equivalent or silently erase a fragment. P09.8 audits all exception hashes/replay and declaration classification, confirms cap and raw report arithmetic. Any exclusion after source change expires.

CI materializes one job per package-fragment with min threshold; max-parallel=4, threads=1; separate checkout+coverage+unique *_test DB per worker, root coverage sequential. Job timeout-minutes=60, per-mutant process timeout=10s (timeouts remain valid), initial suite timeout=600s; measured receipts show duration. Every zone repair item budget two 4h rounds, then blocked with survivors; no unbounded test rewrite. --zone security|messaging|other selects all that zone's fragments and preserves strict inventory; --all combines fresh matching receipts and must refuse gaps/stale/tool changes. Fixed scripts/mutation-check.sh --all remains separate. P09.7 full aggregate final pass once; CI per-fragment shards recreate measurements, not reuse local success blindly.

Security95 required anchors (cannot be downgraded by removing an empty obsolete prefix): Modules/Internal/Gate/{AllowAllActivationGate,ModuleActivationDecision}.php, Modules/Contracts/ModuleActivationGate.php and ALL core/src/Data including Contracts/DataScopeAuthorizer.php, Internal/{AllowAll,Deny,Callable}DataScopeAuthorizer.php and Laravel/SystemDataScopeAuthorization.php. Modules/Gate is an empty legacy directory, not current implementation. Inventory asserts these exact actual files map to core×security95; nonexistent configured roots fail rather than become other75. Negative zone fixtures deliberately change each authorizer/activation path to other or omit it: --inventory --check must exit1 and name the file. Add Data full-prefix plus exact activation contract before other; nonbehavioral declarations retain existing AST/hash rules.

G5 P09.13 additionally owns the three exact Transfer DoD behavioral checks beyond MSI. SqlTransferExecutorTest.php already contains valid cross-job dedup and partial-savepoint behavior; lexical absence is not a missing test. sections.text:

Exporter reuse release_candidate.py preserving deterministic ZIP fixed timestamps/sorting/path-safe extraction/source commit. Strict JSON duplicate-key rejection for policies. Include LICENSE, README/PACKAGE/CHANGELOG/UPGRADE if applicable, config/resources and database/migrations; ship declared schemaSets and resources/boost skills when present, no vendor/tests/secrets/path repositories/local FS/source autoload leakage. If supported static-analysis extension files at package root (core extension.neon/tenancy extension.neon/stubs) required for exported consumers, include them explicitly via package metadata + policy inventory; do not quietly omit. Pristine proof must fail when any required asset absent. Internal require cohort pins =1.0.0-rc.1; third-party constraints remain approved. Source packages no hardcoded version; access-azguard metadata stable and UNRELEASED exception removed before export.
Update docs-public and root RELEASING.md, per-package README/PACKAGE/CHANGELOG: PHP8.4/8.5 Laravel12/13, first rc no prior released upgrade, UUIDv7 fresh schema via corex:schema:migrate; public Api/Spi code, typed config, error wire/lifecycle tests, minimal install and opt-in bridges. API/async/extension fixture/equipment proofs parameterized --candidate --receipt --evidence-dir as needed and rebuilt for current CoreX Api/schema/wire; tests cannot execute fixtures from old installed delivery directories. CycloneDX plugin6.2.0 allow only exact plugin. SBOM per clean consumer lock/profile, not monorepo dev graph; no-dev packages and exact main component rc, --output-reproducible. Source full composer example is canonical in examples candidate; type=metapackage with require.php ^8.4, internal requires ^1.0@dev, minimum-stability stable, prefer-stable true, branch-alias dev-main 1.0.x-dev and path repos ../<resolved-public-package-dir>. Missing lock/advisory API failure is not success; denied/offline audits remain pending. No allow-plugins=true. sections.title: 7. P09.7: exact rc evidence and publication packet
sections.text:

Build twice from same clean final committed source, no dirty product/policy input; SHA must match. Any source product/config/test/lock change invalidates candidate+coverage+qualification. Plan-only bookkeeping change permits explicit lineage and identical product fingerprint, never an unchecked different commit.

P09.16 creates operator_packet.py and release-qualification.yml PHP8.4/8.5 × Laravel12/13 with full SHA actions, permissions:{} / contents:read only, per-fragment MSI jobs and isolated databases. Local implementation of workflow and packet is reversible. Actual branch push/dispatch is OWNER-OPERATED EXTERNAL PRECONDITION P09-HOSTED: owner selects repository, branch ref (no tags), exact committed source+workflow SHA, push+dispatch operation and pinned private dependency delivery from D124. Owner may supply hosted runs already produced. Agent in this design has no push/dispatch grant; neither future publisher nor automatic split trigger is created. Missing precondition blocks P09.17 and P09.8 closure; owner permission for hosting is separate from later publication. Read-only gh auth/status and repository/run reads are checked before operator step; mirror existence/visibility and Packagist name availability are unknown until read-only preflight, never evidence invented.

Hosted final workflow CI run must be completed/success on phase final commit with every required job success; release-qualification four cells must success for SAME source and SAME candidate/archive digest. Host runner receives approved sealed candidate through protected input or rebuilds deterministically; if repeated zip hashes differ, exporter repair/requalification required, not semantic-equivalence waiver. Retain workflow/run/job ids, ref/SHA, actual runtime/version locks and artifact checksums separate from local proof. Private graph missing approved input/read access remains blocked; public-only pass cannot certify full matrix.

zizmor is not installed locally. P09.17 V34 uses existing CI job Workflow supply chain security via zizmorcore/zizmor-action SHA cc914d7f3750a2d13d75c7f184a1060aa0e9d482, version v1.30.1; hosted job must actually inspect .github/workflows including new workflow on exact commit and succeed (D18). No which/local binary claim, no installation without scope.

Operator packet version/source/cohort, per resource repository/channel/ref/tag/tree/commit/archive sha256 and requested operations/preflight. CHECKSUMS.sha256 uses sha256sum text format plus canonical packet digest; UNSIGNED, signature_status=not-requested. No signed-provenance claim, key or credentials needed. Signing is separate future owner-approved action specifying key/format/operator; not a P09 acceptance assertion. Split tree/commit delivery fields cannot be final until D122 accepted and matching sealed result proven. Operator UNASSIGNED until owner; publication status=pending-owner-grant. D123 channel classification governs private packet storage; no upload disclosure inferred. External publication later checks exact resource approval, collision/visibility, never force/overwrite/delete/rebuild silently.

No qualification/hosted cycle: P09.6 exporter smoke → P09.16 local workflow/packet builder+tests → final committed product snapshot → P09.7 current rc/all proofs plus operator_packet.py --candidate --evidence --output build/release/operator-packet.json → exact owner-operated, runtime owner_gate P09.17 push/dispatch → P09.8 read-only review. Packet is build output, not a product source edit. P09.17 never changes workflows/product; any needed change returns to P09.16 then invalidates/repeats P09.7. This ensures owner reviews concrete workflow/ref/SHA/packet before external action.

Runtime authority: P09.6/P09.16 share only owner_gate P09-RELEASE-POLICY (D122/D123+closure/effective D19). P09.16 has no residual P09-HOSTED gate/scope and remains local preparation. P09.17 uses owner_gate P09-HOSTED for owner-operated external action/proof; current Task external_gate cannot be started or owner-granted. Existing owner policy answers may authorize the policy grant within their quoted scope; never ask again for the same authorized choice, nor infer execution or remote grants from a design request. Any scope/fingerprint mismatch stays STOP. Read-only validation of actual grant events and exact evidence remains V0/V2; runtime grant marker alone does not establish policy or hosted success.

Owner resolution: manifest header plan_id=2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL, owner records use fully qualified PLAN3.P09.<n> (multiple owners permitted) and purpose producer/consumer. sections.title: 8. Acceptance, failure recovery and final review
sections.text:
Every item has exact commands. New scripts/commands are deliverables of owning item, not assumed to exist at design. New gate must have representative injected violation control with restoration in temp fixture/worktree. No test for plan prose added. Common environment: scripts/php84 --check; PG tests only after db-test-preflight, PGSQL_PORT5434, *_test DB. No test mutates development data. PG unavailability means affected acceptance pending, never falling back to SQLite.
Failure categories: tool resolution conflict -> preserve locked versions and use composer why-not; unresolved compatible upgrade -> report concrete version conflict; type correction changes public semantics -> separate decision/API delta/CHANGELOG before continue; schema bytes differ -> reject type/style change, fix behavior and resnapshot real schema; MSI empty/error -> fix runner/data, not threshold; stale receipt -> rebuild from source; absent private dependency artifact -> private closure blocked, never mark public-only qualification complete; hosted CI red -> owning fix and affected checks, no waived success under old D106; external write requested -> owner exact grant after reviewable packet. Owner D122/D123/D124 are intentionally unresolved and stop dependent items. No execution admission before new independent design review.
Final Review P09 read-only with fresh different model: item specs+phase diff+acceptance outputs only; product hashes before/after unchanged; report exact GREEN/FINDINGS and evidence integrity. Repair findings in owning item, re-run affected acceptance, bounded re-review; final hosted CI proof must match product candidate source (and phase final commit where different, explicit lineage+unchanged product hashes), workflow CI all jobs success under D73. Missing hosted proof leaves closure pending. Publication remains separately owner gated. Review does not execute full suites again merely to inflate logs.
Self-check design: every item enumerates directories/commands, known algorithms and thresholds; no product policy left to executor; current facts recorded and fresh type diagnostics belong execution. Broad behavior run one final time; item checks sized by public/schema/security impact. No acceptance pass asserted at design.
P09.1/P09.7/P09.16/P09.17/P09.8 reject scripts/.plan-close-deferred before any acceptance. All current validations are planned execution checks, not reported as passed in this design. Fresh final evidence cannot borrow P09.6 smoke hashes or historical PLAN2 receipts. Design check/render are consistency proof only. Unverified Infection/Rector-Laravel/CycloneDX dependency solve and flags are bounded execution preflight, not compatibility claims.
Grok G1/G2 repaired against real Task lifecycle.py: use supported owner_gate identities; readiness/policy/hosted grants remain future and absent now. External evidence is a receipt precondition, not the unstartable external_gate authority kind. Current design still blocked by open D122–D124 and corrected-design re-review.

sections.title: Grok G1–G6 verified design corrections

sections.title: Пул и роли

`auto` и модели вне пула запрещены. Reviewer model всегда ≠ executor model.

sections.title: Native launch
sections.text:
Codex (implementation/high):

```bash
codex -C "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" -m gpt-6-sol -c 'model_reasoning_effort="high"' -a never -s danger-full-access '$ task:plan-run 2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL <exact-items-from-sheet>'
```

Cursor (effort — нативным селектором до запуска):

```bash
agent --workspace "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" --model grok-4.7 --force --sandbox disabled --trust --approve-mcps 'task:plan-run 2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL <exact-items-from-sheet>'
```

Claude Code для B05-A (D85): `claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5`, затем `task:plan-run 2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL P05.1 P05.2`.

Claude Code для opus: `claude --model opus`, затем `task:plan-run 2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL <items>`.

sections.title: Full review runbook
sections.text:
1. После зелёной Validation, до finalize — свежий actor/context на reviewer model/effort из той же строки sheet.
2. Вход: item-spec, diff (или артефакты), вывод Validation. Reviewer read-only, не чинит; prompt:
   `read-only full review for <admission>; do not repair or finalize`.
3. Findings → owning executor чинит в текущем Scope → affected checks → reviewer перепроверяет. ≤2 раунда, затем эскалация.
4. Строка `review: <provider>/<model> <GREEN|findings:N>` в Completion Notes.

sections.title: Эстафета
sections.text:
Любой агент завершает команду переписанным `@plan/plan.json` с одним semantic Next и launch-block из строки execution-sheet.
Следующий агент стартует только по этому Next (`git pull --ff-only` из корня клона).
